We currently have two open faculty positions (for assistant or potentially associate professors) in Systems and Human Computing (a broad area including HCI, information systems, software engineering, as well as other related topics) at the Department of Computer Science, Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, in Santiago, Chile. Applications should be submitted by April 30.

You can find full details at the following links

If you have any questions (about the position, or about the university or Chile) please feel free to contact me. Also, please feel free to distribute this information among anyone who might be interested in applying.
